label: Freelancehunt
terms_note: Personal API key (self-serve); rate-limited (429 + headers); JSON:API; terms on automated bidding not readable this pass.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (official API 2.0 with personal keys). Lane `assist` → **api for search + profile**, bids pending endpoint + rules check. Confidence high (docs read via r.jina.ai — page is JS).
auth: 1. Log in → freelancehunt.com/my/api2 → generate API key.

endpoints.notes: id, attributes (name, description, budget{amount,currency}, skills…), links.self

reference.limits: - Rate limit across all API queries: X-Ratelimit-Limit (average over time), X-Ratelimit-Remaining (points), 429 when exceeded; some endpoints add their own limits. - Site rules on automated bids not readable (cookie-policy page returned).

fields.name: token
fields.help: Personal API token from https://freelancehunt.com/my/api2, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

adapter.rate_note: 'Freelancehunt rate-limits requests … HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests)' with X-Ratelimit-Limit / X-Ratelimit-Remaining headers; no numbers are published. One request per second.

search_postings.note: GET /v2/projects ('Open projects list'; by default open projects). Pagination is page[number]; filter[skill_id] takes comma-separated skill IDs (GET /v2/skills), so pass skill ids as category. No keyword or budget filter is documented, so query and min_budget are not sent and the page size is the platform's (limit is not sent). budget is a single amount (budget_max) in budget.currency; skills[] are {id, name} objects (raw).

list_messages.note: GET /v2/threads/{thread_id} ('Thread messages list'); thread_id is required (GET /v2/threads lists threads). from/to are the participants' logins.

send_message.note: POST /v2/threads/{thread_id} ('Add message to the thread') with {message_html}.

config_fields.name: safe_type
config_fields.help: Default payment protection for new bids: split, employer, developer or employer_cashless (Safe), per the 'Add bid' docs; leave unset for the platform default.

not_offered.withdraw_bid: Revoking needs both ids (POST /v2/projects/{project_id}/bids/{bid_id}/revoke); the vocabulary's withdraw_bid carries bid_id only.
not_offered.bid_status: No per-bid endpoint: bids are listed with GET /v2/my/bids (filter[project_id], filter[status]) or per project, not fetched by bid id.
not_offered.credits: No credit or balance endpoint in the API 2.0 collection.
not_offered.submit_bid: POST /v2/projects/{project_id}/bids ('Add bid' in the Freelancehunt API 2.0 Postman collection) now answers 410 Gone: "This public endpoint is no longer available due to API v2 deprecation." (auth audit 2026-09-26, sent with a dummy token; the refusal comes before authentication).

evidence: host api.freelancehunt.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 4/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://documenter.gw.postman.com/api/collections/3971751/S1Lzy7WU?segregateAuth=true&versionTag=latest: 5/5 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
auth_audit.notes: Fixed: submit_bid removed; POST /v2/projects/{id}/bids answers 410 'This public endpoint is no longer available due to API v2 deprecation.' The search 500 was caused by the dummy non-numeric skill id. inconclusive: search_postings: server_error 500
